title: Environment, Health & Economy
sub: IELTS topic vocabulary for essays and speaking.

cards.def:
Keeping something in its original state
हिंदी: संरक्षण
examples: The preservation of forests protects water supplies.
The trust works on the preservation of old temples.
Wildlife preservation needs support from local villages.
Proper storage helps in the preservation of old books.

cards.def:
Gases released into the air
हिंदी: उत्सर्जन
examples: Factories must reduce emissions.
Electric buses help cut emissions in big cities.
The company publishes its emissions every year.
Vehicle emissions are a major cause of smog in winter.

cards.def:
Coal, oil and gas formed from ancient organisms
हिंदी: जीवाश्म ईंधन
examples: Fossil fuels remain the main source of energy.
Burning fossil fuels releases carbon dioxide.
India still depends heavily on fossil fuels for electricity.
The government wants to reduce imports of fossil fuels.

cards.def:
Energy obtained from the sun
हिंदी: सौर ऊर्जा
examples: Solar power is booming in rural India.
We installed solar power on our roof to cut electricity bills.
Solar power works best in sunny states like Rajasthan.
The village school runs entirely on solar power.

cards.def:
A machine that converts wind into electricity
हिंदी: पवन टरबाइन
examples: Offshore wind turbines generate large amounts of power.
We saw rows of wind turbines on the drive to Kanyakumari.
A single wind turbine can power hundreds of homes.
Some people complain that wind turbines are noisy.

cards.def:
Severe and unusual weather events
हिंदी: चरम मौसम
examples: Extreme weather is becoming more common.
Extreme weather destroyed crops across the state.
Cities must prepare for extreme weather like heatwaves.
Flights were cancelled because of extreme weather.

cards.def:
Overflow of water onto normally dry land
हिंदी: बाढ़
examples: Heavy rains caused severe flooding.
Flooding in Mumbai stops local trains every monsoon.
Blocked drains make flooding worse.
The farmers lost their harvest to flooding.

cards.def:
The wearing away of topsoil
हिंदी: मिट्टी का कटाव
examples: Soil erosion reduces farm productivity.
Planting trees on slopes reduces soil erosion.
Soil erosion has made the land less fertile.
Heavy rain and deforestation speed up soil erosion.

cards.def:
Water held underground in soil and rocks
हिंदी: भूजल
examples: Excessive pumping depletes groundwater.
Groundwater levels in Punjab are falling fast.
Many villages depend on groundwater for drinking.
Rainwater harvesting helps refill groundwater.

cards.def:
To use up resources so little remains
हिंदी: ख़त्म करते जाना
examples: Overfishing has depleted ocean stocks.
Long working hours depleted her energy.
The drought depleted the city's water reserves.
Our savings were depleted after the hospital bills.

cards.def:
To use up completely
हिंदी: पूरी तरह इस्तेमाल कर डालना
examples: We risk exhausting natural resources.
The long trek exhausted all our water supply.
The family exhausted their savings on the wedding.
Don't exhaust your budget in the first month.

cards.def:
To use resources, often unfairly or excessively
हिंदी: दोहन करना
examples: Companies exploit forests for timber.
Some factories exploit cheap labour.
The mining company exploited the region's minerals for decades.
Rules are needed so businesses don't exploit natural resources.

cards.def:
To damage or lower the quality of
हिंदी: बिगाड़ना
examples: Pollution degrades water quality.
Plastic waste degrades the beauty of our beaches.
Overgrazing degrades grassland.
Heat can degrade the quality of medicines.

cards.def:
To make impure by adding a harmful substance
हिंदी: दूषित करना
examples: Industrial waste contaminated the river.
Sewage contaminated the village well.
Wash your hands so you don't contaminate the food.
The lab sample was contaminated and had to be tested again.

cards.def:
The cleanliness of the air
हिंदी: हवा की गुणवत्ता
examples: Poor air quality causes respiratory disease.
Delhi's air quality gets very bad in November.
Check the air quality index before going for a run.
Planting trees can improve air quality in cities.

cards.def:
Plastic products designed to be used once
हिंदी: एक बार इस्तेमाल होने वाला प्लास्टिक
examples: Many countries ban single-use plastic bags.
Our office stopped using single-use plastic cups.
Single-use plastic often ends up in rivers and oceans.
Carry a cloth bag to avoid single-use plastic.

cards.def:
Using resources faster than they can be replaced
हिंदी: अत्यधिक उपभोग
examples: Overconsumption drives environmental damage.
Overconsumption of water is a problem in big cities.
Fast fashion encourages overconsumption.
Overconsumption of sugar leads to health problems.

cards.def:
Not harmful to the environment
हिंदी: पर्यावरण के अनुकूल
examples: Eco-friendly products are growing in popularity.
We chose eco-friendly decorations for the festival.
Eco-friendly packaging costs a little more.
The hotel follows eco-friendly practices like solar heating.

cards.def:
Areas of parks and nature in cities
हिंदी: हरित क्षेत्र
examples: Green spaces improve mental wellbeing.
New housing projects must include green space for children.
Bengaluru is losing its green space to construction.
The office has a small green space for lunch breaks.

cards.def:
Produced without artificial chemicals
हिंदी: जैविक
examples: Organic produce is often more expensive.
We buy organic vegetables from a local farm.
Organic farming avoids chemical fertilisers.
The shop sells organic rice and pulses.

cards.def:
A chemical used to kill pests
हिंदी: कीटनाशक
examples: Pesticides can harm bees.
Wash fruit well to remove any pesticide.
Farmers are switching to natural pesticide options.
Too much pesticide can harm the farmer's health.

cards.def:
Farming a single crop over a large area
हिंदी: एकल फ़सल खेती
examples: Monoculture depletes soil nutrients.
Monoculture makes crops more vulnerable to disease.
Large tea estates are a form of monoculture.
Experts suggest mixing crops instead of monoculture.

cards.def:
Extreme scarcity of food
हिंदी: अकाल
examples: War and drought caused a famine.
The Bengal famine of 1943 killed millions of people.
Aid agencies are working to prevent famine in the region.
Crop failure for two years led to famine.

cards.def:
Giving a vaccine to protect against disease
हिंदी: टीकाकरण
examples: Mass vaccination reduced infection rates.
Vaccination drives are held in schools every year.
Polio vaccination made India polio-free.
Check your child's vaccination card before school admission.

cards.def:
Capable of causing death
हिंदी: जानलेवा
examples: Delays in treatment can be life-threatening.
Snake bites can be life-threatening without quick treatment.
The patient's condition is serious but not life-threatening.
Severe allergies can be life-threatening.

cards.def:
Employees able to cope with stress and change
हिंदी: तनाव झेलने में सक्षम कार्यबल
examples: Training builds a resilient workforce.
A resilient workforce recovers quickly from big changes.
Mental health support helps build a resilient workforce.
The pandemic showed the value of a resilient workforce.

cards.def:
The supply of medical services
हिंदी: स्वास्थ्य सेवाओं की उपलब्धता
examples: Rural healthcare provision is inadequate.
The state is improving healthcare provision in villages.
Healthcare provision is better in cities than in rural areas.
The report criticised the poor healthcare provision for the elderly.

cards.def:
Health services available to all citizens
हिंदी: सार्वभौमिक स्वास्थ्य सेवा
examples: Universal healthcare reduces inequality.
Many countries in Europe have universal healthcare.
Universal healthcare is expensive but saves lives.
Should India move towards universal healthcare?

cards.def:
A list of people waiting for treatment or service
हिंदी: प्रतीक्षा सूची
examples: Long waiting lists delay surgery.
The waiting list for the school is two years long.
She is on the waiting list for a kidney transplant.
My train ticket is still on the waiting list.

cards.def:
Able to be stopped from happening
हिंदी: रोकथाम योग्य
examples: Many deaths are preventable with early screening.
Most road accidents are preventable.
Diabetes is often preventable with a healthy lifestyle.
The fire was preventable with basic safety checks.

cards.def:
Food containing all necessary nutrients in right proportions
हिंदी: संतुलित आहार
examples: A balanced diet prevents many diseases.
My doctor told me to follow a balanced diet.
A balanced diet includes dal, rice, vegetables and curd.
Schools teach children about a balanced diet.

cards.def:
Food high in calories but low in nutrition
हिंदी: अस्वास्थ्यकर खाना
examples: Junk food advertising targets children.
Too much junk food can lead to obesity.
Schools have banned junk food in canteens.
I eat junk food only on weekends.

cards.def:
Food altered from its natural state
हिंदी: प्रसंस्कृत खाद्य
examples: Processed food often contains too much sugar.
Processed food is convenient for busy families.
Read labels on processed food for hidden salt.
Doctors advise eating less processed food.

cards.def:
A substance needed for growth and health
हिंदी: पोषक तत्व
examples: Fruit and vegetables provide essential nutrients.
Spinach is full of important nutrients.
Cooking for too long can destroy nutrients.
Plants take nutrients from the soil.

cards.def:
Any movement of the body that uses energy
हिंदी: शारीरिक गतिविधि
examples: Daily physical activity reduces heart disease risk.
Children need at least an hour of physical activity daily.
Walking to work is an easy form of physical activity.
Physical activity helps reduce stress.

cards.def:
A way of living involving little exercise
हिंदी: गतिहीन जीवनशैली
examples: A sedentary lifestyle causes back problems.
Office jobs often lead to a sedentary lifestyle.
A sedentary lifestyle increases the risk of diabetes.
Take short walks to break your sedentary lifestyle.

cards.def:
The total value of goods and services produced in a country
हिंदी: सकल घरेलू उत्पाद
examples: GDP growth slowed to two percent.
India's GDP has grown quickly over the last decade.
Agriculture's share of GDP is shrinking.
GDP doesn't measure people's happiness.

cards.def:
A country with a lower standard of living and industry
हिंदी: विकासशील देश
examples: Developing nations need affordable technology.
Developing nations often struggle with infrastructure.
Many developing nations depend on farming.
Mobile banking has helped people in developing nations.

cards.def:
A country growing rapidly into a developed economy
हिंदी: उभरती अर्थव्यवस्था
examples: India is a major emerging economy.
Emerging economies attract investors looking for growth.
Brazil is another large emerging economy.
Emerging economies often face currency swings.

cards.def:
A restriction on international trade
हिंदी: व्यापार बाधा
examples: Tariffs act as trade barriers.
The new deal removes trade barriers between the two countries.
Import quotas are a common trade barrier.
Trade barriers make foreign goods more expensive.

cards.def:
Money invested from overseas into a country
हिंदी: विदेशी निवेश
examples: Foreign investment boosted the manufacturing sector.
Foreign investment created thousands of jobs in Tamil Nadu.
The government relaxed rules to attract foreign investment.
Foreign investment fell during the global slowdown.

cards.def:
Contracting work to external parties, often overseas
हिंदी: काम बाहर से करवाना
examples: Outsourcing reduces costs but may cut local jobs.
Many US firms use outsourcing for customer support.
Outsourcing payroll saved the company time.
Outsourcing created many jobs in Indian cities.

cards.def:
Moving business operations to another country
हिंदी: व्यवसाय विदेश में स्थानांतरित करना
examples: Offshoring has transformed the IT industry.
Offshoring moved many factory jobs to Asia.
The company's offshoring plan worried local staff.
Offshoring works best with clear communication.

cards.def:
A company operating in many countries
हिंदी: बहुराष्ट्रीय कंपनी
examples: Multinationals bring jobs and expertise.
She works for a multinational with offices in twenty countries.
Multinationals often pay higher salaries.
The multinational opened a new research centre in Pune.

cards.def:
Money left after taxes and essentials
हिंदी: ख़र्च योग्य आय
examples: Rising prices reduced disposable income.
Higher rent left me with less disposable income.
Young professionals spend their disposable income on travel.
Tax cuts increase disposable income.

cards.def:
Money spent by government on services
हिंदी: सार्वजनिक व्यय
examples: Public spending on health must rise.
Public spending on roads increased this year.
Cuts in public spending affect schools and hospitals.
Public spending rises before elections.

cards.def:
Regular payment to retired people
हिंदी: पेंशन
examples: Pensions are under pressure from ageing populations.
My grandfather lives on his government pension.
Start saving for your pension early.
The company contributes to employees' pension funds.

cards.def:
Government support for the unemployed, elderly and disabled
हिंदी: सामाजिक सुरक्षा
examples: Social security prevents extreme hardship.
Social security helps elderly people who can't work.
Some countries spend a lot on social security.
Gig workers often lack social security.

cards.def:
Wealthy and prosperous
हिंदी: संपन्न
examples: Affluent families can afford private schooling.
Affluent neighbourhoods have better roads and parks.
The new mall targets affluent shoppers.
Even in affluent countries, some people are poor.

cards.def:
Successful and flourishing financially
हिंदी: समृद्ध
examples: A prosperous economy attracts skilled workers.
The town became prosperous after the factory opened.
We wish you a happy and prosperous new year.
Trade made the port city prosperous.

cards.def:
Made poor
हिंदी: निर्धन बना दिया गया
examples: The impoverished region lacks basic services.
The drought left many farmers impoverished.
The charity runs schools for impoverished children.
War impoverished the once-rich region.

cards.def:
Extremely poor and lacking basic needs
हिंदी: अत्यंत निर्धन
examples: War left thousands of families destitute.
The flood left many families destitute.
The charity provides food for destitute people.
He was destitute after losing his job and home.

cards.def:
The use of goods and resources
हिंदी: उपभोग
examples: Energy consumption doubled in twenty years.
Electricity consumption rises in summer.
Reduce your sugar consumption for better health.
Consumption of online video is growing fast.

cards.def:
Forces causing prices to rise
हिंदी: मुद्रास्फीति का दबाव
examples: Higher wages created inflationary pressure.
A weak monsoon adds inflationary pressure on food prices.
Rising fuel costs create inflationary pressure.
The central bank is watching inflationary pressure closely.

cards.def:
Characterised by conflict or confusion
हिंदी: उथल-पुथल भरा
examples: The company survived a turbulent decade.
The country went through a turbulent political period.
Our flight was turbulent over the mountains.
Markets were turbulent after the election.

cards.def:
Showing no activity or growth
हिंदी: ठहरा हुआ
examples: Wages remained stagnant for years.
Sales have been stagnant for three quarters.
Stagnant water breeds mosquitoes.
He felt his career was stagnant and looked for a new job.

cards.def:
A decline in economic activity
हिंदी: आर्थिक गिरावट
examples: The downturn forced companies to cut jobs.
The downturn hit the real estate sector hardest.
Many startups closed during the downturn.
Save money during good times to survive a downturn.

cards.def:
An improvement in economic conditions
हिंदी: आर्थिक सुधार
examples: An upturn in exports boosted growth.
Hotels saw an upturn in bookings after the holidays began.
An upturn in demand helped the car industry.
The company expects an upturn in the second half.

cards.def:
A period of rapid economic growth
हिंदी: तेज़ आर्थिक उछाल
examples: The housing boom pushed prices up.
The IT boom created jobs for millions of graduates.
During the boom, property prices doubled.
There's a boom in online shopping in small towns.

cards.def:
A sudden collapse of economic activity
हिंदी: अचानक आर्थिक पतन
examples: The boom ended in a painful bust.
Many dot-com companies disappeared in the bust.
Boom and bust cycles are common in property markets.
Investors who borrowed heavily lost everything in the bust.

cards.def:
The industry of travel for pleasure
हिंदी: पर्यटन
examples: Tourism is a major source of foreign income.
Goa depends heavily on tourism.
The pandemic hit tourism very hard.
Tourism creates jobs for guides, drivers and hotel staff.

cards.def:
Responsible travel to natural areas
हिंदी: पर्यावरण-अनुकूल पर्यटन
examples: Ecotourism supports local communities and wildlife.
Ecotourism in Kerala lets visitors stay with local families.
Ecotourism lodges use solar power and local food.
Good ecotourism leaves nature as it was found.

cards.def:
A place of historic or cultural importance
हिंदी: धरोहर स्थल
examples: The temple is a protected heritage site.
Hampi is a famous heritage site in Karnataka.
Climbing on walls is not allowed at the heritage site.
The old fort was declared a heritage site last year.

cards.def:
Too many people in a limited space
हिंदी: अत्यधिक भीड़
examples: Overcrowding at popular sites damages the environment.
Overcrowding in local trains is common during rush hour.
Overcrowding in schools makes teaching difficult.
The hill station suffers from overcrowding every summer.

cards.def:
Large-scale tourism by many visitors
हिंदी: बड़े पैमाने का पर्यटन
examples: Mass tourism strains local infrastructure.
Mass tourism has filled the beaches with plastic.
Some cities limit mass tourism with entry fees.
Mass tourism brings money but also traffic.

cards.def:
Involving more than one culture
हिंदी: अंतर-सांस्कृतिक
examples: Cross-cultural understanding reduces conflict.
Our team does cross-cultural training before client visits.
Cross-cultural marriages are common in big cities.
Cross-cultural misunderstandings can happen in global teams.

cards.def:
Including people from many parts of the world
हिंदी: बहुसांस्कृतिक
examples: Bengaluru is a cosmopolitan city.
Mumbai has a cosmopolitan food scene.
She grew up in a cosmopolitan family with relatives abroad.
The cosmopolitan crowd at the conference came from forty countries.

cards.def:
Relating to several cultural groups
हिंदी: बहुसांस्कृतिक
examples: A multicultural society benefits from diverse ideas.
Our office is multicultural, with staff from many states.
Multicultural festivals help people learn about each other.
Schools in multicultural cities teach respect for all faiths.

cards.def:
Able to speak two languages
हिंदी: द्विभाषी
examples: Bilingual children often have better memory.
Many Indians are bilingual in Hindi and English.
The company needs bilingual staff for its call centre.
Our bilingual website is in English and Tamil.

cards.def:
The ability to speak a language smoothly
हिंदी: प्रवाह
examples: Fluency comes from regular speaking practice.
Watching English films helped my fluency.
Fluency matters more than perfect grammar in conversation.
The job requires fluency in French.

cards.def:
A language at risk of falling out of use
हिंदी: विलुप्तप्राय भाषा
examples: Many endangered languages have no written form.
Linguists are recording an endangered language in Arunachal.
When the last speaker dies, an endangered language is lost.
Apps can help young people learn an endangered language.

cards.def:
A common language between speakers of different native languages
हिंदी: संपर्क भाषा
examples: English is the lingua franca of business.
Hindi often acts as a lingua franca in northern India.
In the ship's crew, English was the lingua franca.
Swahili is a lingua franca in East Africa.

cards.def:
A person's first language
हिंदी: मातृभाषा
examples: Primary education in the mother tongue improves understanding.
My mother tongue is Marathi, but I work in English.
Children should be proud of their mother tongue.
She dreams in her mother tongue, not in English.

cards.def:
Sharing of culture between countries or groups
हिंदी: सांस्कृतिक आदान-प्रदान
examples: Student exchange programmes encourage cultural exchange.
The festival promotes cultural exchange between India and Japan.
Cultural exchange programmes build friendships between countries.
Food is a delicious form of cultural exchange.

cards.def:
People settled away from their ancestral homeland
हिंदी: प्रवासी समुदाय
examples: The Indian diaspora supports many causes at home.
The Indian diaspora celebrates Diwali around the world.
Many diaspora families send money home every month.
The diaspora in the Gulf is very large.

cards.def:
Help given to those in need
हिंदी: सहायता
examples: International aid supports rebuilding efforts.
Aid reached the flood victims after three days.
The country receives aid for its health programmes.
Food aid was dropped by helicopter.

cards.def:
A natural system that absorbs more carbon than it releases
हिंदी: कार्बन सोखने वाला प्राकृतिक तंत्र
examples: Forests act as a vital carbon sink.
Mangroves are an important carbon sink on the coast.
Oceans are the largest carbon sink on Earth.
Cutting forests reduces the planet's carbon sink.

cards.def:
A reduction in emissions made to compensate for others
हिंदी: कार्बन उत्सर्जन की भरपाई
examples: Airlines sell carbon offsets to passengers.
The company buys carbon offsets for its business travel.
Critics say some carbon offset projects don't work.
Tree planting is a popular carbon offset.

cards.def:
Trapping carbon dioxide before it enters the atmosphere
हिंदी: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड को पकड़ना
examples: Carbon capture could cut industrial emissions.
Carbon capture is still expensive.
The cement plant is testing carbon capture technology.
Carbon capture alone can't solve climate change.

cards.def:
Cheap clothing produced quickly for trends
हिंदी: सस्ते व जल्दी बदलते फ़ैशन के कपड़े
examples: Fast fashion creates huge amounts of textile waste.
Fast fashion makes clothes cheap but short-lived.
She stopped buying fast fashion and shops second-hand.
Fast fashion brands release new styles every week.

cards.def:
Designing products to become outdated quickly
हिंदी: जानबूझकर जल्दी पुराना होने वाली डिज़ाइन
examples: Planned obsolescence pushes people to buy new phones.
Planned obsolescence makes printers stop working after a few years.
Some countries have laws against planned obsolescence.
Planned obsolescence creates a lot of electronic waste.

cards.def:
The point at which change becomes irreversible
हिंदी: वह बिंदु जिसके बाद बदलाव अपरिवर्तनीय हो जाए
examples: Scientists warn of climate tipping points.
The price rise was the tipping point for many customers.
Losing the client was the tipping point that made him resign.
Electric cars may soon reach a tipping point in sales.

cards.def:
Impossible to undo
हिंदी: अपरिवर्तनीय
examples: The damage to the glacier is irreversible.
Some decisions in life are irreversible.
Hearing loss from loud noise can be irreversible.
Think carefully before making an irreversible choice.

cards.def:
Actions to reduce the impact of a problem
हिंदी: प्रभाव घटाने के उपाय
examples: Climate mitigation measures need global cooperation.
The city announced mitigation measures for air pollution.
Mitigation measures include planting trees and cleaner fuel.
Flood mitigation measures saved many homes this year.

cards.def:
Adjusting to new conditions
हिंदी: अनुकूलन
examples: Coastal adaptation will cost billions.
Farmers' adaptation to drought includes new crop varieties.
Adaptation to a new country takes time.
Climate adaptation means building homes on higher ground.

cards.def:
Preparing systems to withstand shocks
हिंदी: झटके सहने की तैयारी की योजना
examples: Cities invest in resilience planning for floods.
Resilience planning helped the hospital keep power during the storm.
Our company does resilience planning for cyber attacks.
Coastal cities need resilience planning for rising seas.

cards.def:
Growing different crops in turn on the same land
हिंदी: फ़सल चक्र
examples: Crop rotation keeps soil fertile.
My grandfather used crop rotation of wheat and pulses.
Crop rotation reduces pests naturally.
Farmers learned about crop rotation from the agriculture office.

cards.def:
Artificial supply of water to land
हिंदी: सिंचाई
examples: Drip irrigation saves water.
Canal irrigation changed farming in Punjab.
Without irrigation, farmers depend only on rain.
The government gives subsidies for irrigation pumps.

cards.def:
A substance added to soil to help plants grow
हिंदी: खाद / उर्वरक
examples: Excess fertiliser pollutes rivers.
Farmers buy fertiliser before the sowing season.
Organic fertiliser is made from cow dung and compost.
Fertiliser prices rose sharply this year.

cards.def:
Having altered genes
हिंदी: आनुवंशिक रूप से संशोधित
examples: Genetically modified crops can resist pests.
Genetically modified cotton is widely grown in India.
Some people avoid genetically modified food.
Scientists created a genetically modified rice with more vitamins.

cards.def:
An underground layer holding groundwater
हिंदी: भूमिगत जलभंडार
examples: The aquifer is shrinking each year.
The city's wells draw water from a deep aquifer.
Pollution can seep into the aquifer.
It takes many years to refill an aquifer.

cards.def:
An area of land draining into a common water source
हिंदी: जलग्रहण क्षेत्र
examples: Protecting the watershed secures city water.
Building on the watershed can cause water shortages.
The NGO plants trees to protect the watershed.
Rain from the whole watershed flows into this river.

cards.def:
A large natural or artificial lake for water storage
हिंदी: जलाशय
examples: Reservoir levels dropped during the drought.
The reservoir supplies drinking water to the city.
Water was released from the reservoir after heavy rain.
Families picnic near the reservoir on weekends.

cards.def:
Resources that replenish naturally
हिंदी: नवीकरणीय संसाधन
examples: Wind and water are renewable resources.
Countries are investing more in renewable resources.
Forests are renewable resources if managed well.
Renewable resources can reduce our energy imports.

cards.def:
Not able to be replaced naturally in a short time
हिंदी: अनवीकरणीय
examples: Coal is a non-renewable resource.
Oil is non-renewable, so prices will rise as it runs out.
Non-renewable energy still powers most factories.
Using non-renewable resources wisely is important.

cards.def:
Using less energy for the same result
हिंदी: ऊर्जा दक्षता
examples: Energy efficiency cuts bills and emissions.
LED bulbs improve energy efficiency at home.
Look for the energy efficiency star rating on fridges.
Better energy efficiency lowers office costs.

cards.def:
A network delivering electricity
हिंदी: बिजली ग्रिड
examples: Renewables strain the power grid.
A fault in the power grid caused blackouts in three states.
Solar farms feed electricity into the power grid.
The power grid struggles during summer peak demand.

cards.def:
Energy produced by nuclear reactions
हिंदी: परमाणु ऊर्जा
examples: Nuclear power produces low-carbon electricity.
Nuclear power plants need strict safety rules.
Some countries are phasing out nuclear power.
India plans to expand nuclear power generation.

cards.def:
Using heat from within the Earth
हिंदी: भूतापीय
examples: Geothermal energy is stable and clean.
Iceland heats homes with geothermal energy.
Geothermal plants work day and night.
Hot springs are a sign of geothermal activity.

cards.def:
Electricity generated from flowing water
हिंदी: जल विद्युत
examples: Hydropower provides much of the region's energy.
Himachal Pradesh produces a lot of hydropower.
Big hydropower dams can displace villages.
Hydropower depends on good rainfall.

cards.def:
A vehicle powered by electricity
हिंदी: इलेक्ट्रिक वाहन
examples: Electric vehicle sales doubled this year.
My neighbour bought an electric vehicle to save on petrol.
Electric vehicle owners can charge at home overnight.
The city is replacing old buses with electric vehicles.

cards.def:
Facilities for recharging electric vehicles
हिंदी: चार्जिंग की सुविधाएँ
examples: Charging infrastructure remains limited in small towns.
Highways need better charging infrastructure for long trips.
Companies are building charging infrastructure in malls.
Poor charging infrastructure slows down EV adoption.

cards.def:
General knowledge of an issue among people
हिंदी: जन जागरूकता
examples: Public awareness campaigns reduced littering.
Public awareness about mental health is growing.
The campaign raised public awareness about road safety.
Public awareness can change people's habits.

cards.def:
A movement started by ordinary people
हिंदी: आम लोगों द्वारा शुरू किया गया अभियान
examples: A grassroots campaign saved the local forest.
A grassroots campaign cleaned up the local lake.
The grassroots campaign started with a few college students.
Grassroots campaigns rely on volunteers and social media.

cards.def:
Deterioration of the natural environment
हिंदी: पर्यावरणीय क्षरण
examples: Environmental degradation harms public health.
Mining has caused serious environmental degradation in the area.
Environmental degradation affects poor communities first.
Laws aim to stop environmental degradation of rivers.

cards.def:
Harmful or annoying levels of noise
हिंदी: ध्वनि प्रदूषण
examples: Noise pollution affects sleep and stress.
Firecrackers cause noise pollution during festivals.
Living near the airport means constant noise pollution.
Noise pollution makes it hard for students to study.

cards.def:
Excessive artificial light at night
हिंदी: प्रकाश प्रदूषण
examples: Light pollution disturbs migrating birds.
Light pollution makes it hard to see stars in the city.
Streetlights pointing upwards add to light pollution.
Some towns turn off lights at night to reduce light pollution.

cards.def:
Catching fish faster than they can reproduce
हिंदी: अत्यधिक मछली पकड़ना
examples: Overfishing is emptying the oceans.
Overfishing has reduced the catch for local fishermen.
Fishing bans during breeding season help prevent overfishing.
Overfishing harms the whole ocean food chain.

cards.def:
Illegal hunting of wildlife
हिंदी: अवैध शिकार
examples: Poaching pushes rhinos towards extinction.
Forest guards patrol day and night to stop poaching.
Tiger poaching has dropped thanks to strict laws.
Poaching for ivory still threatens elephants.

cards.def:
A protected natural area
हिंदी: राष्ट्रीय उद्यान
examples: Visitors to the national park must follow strict rules.
Jim Corbett is India's oldest national park.
We saw a tiger on our safari in the national park.
Plastic is banned inside the national park.

cards.def:
Aware of and concerned about the environment
हिंदी: पर्यावरण के प्रति जागरूक
examples: Eco-conscious consumers prefer sustainable brands.
Eco-conscious families carry their own bags to the market.
The brand targets young, eco-conscious buyers.
She became eco-conscious after a beach clean-up.

cards.def:
Aiming to send nothing to landfill
हिंदी: शून्य कचरा
examples: Many cafes are going zero waste.
Our office aims to be zero waste by next year.
The zero waste shop sells grains without packaging.
Going zero waste starts with small habits.

cards.def:
To reuse materials to create better-quality items
हिंदी: पुराने से बेहतर चीज़ बनाना
examples: She upcycles old furniture into new designs.
I upcycled old jars into plant pots.
The startup upcycles old saris into bags.
Upcycling is a creative way to reduce waste.

cards.def:
To turn organic waste into fertiliser
हिंदी: जैविक कचरे से खाद बनाना
examples: Many households compost kitchen waste.
We compost vegetable peels on our terrace.
Composting reduces the waste sent to landfills.
The society gives residents bins to compost wet waste.

cards.def:
Replanting trees in cleared areas
हिंदी: दोबारा वन लगाना
examples: Reforestation restores habitats and soil.
Reforestation projects have brought birds back to the hills.
The company funds reforestation as part of its CSR work.
Reforestation takes decades to show full results.

cards.def:
Restoring land to its natural uncultivated state
हिंदी: भूमि को प्राकृतिक अवस्था में लौटाना
examples: Rewilding brought back native species.
Rewilding the riverbank brought back otters.
Rewilding means letting nature take its course.
Some farmers are rewilding unused land.

cards.def:
A way of earning that doesn't harm resources
हिंदी: टिकाऊ आजीविका
examples: Ecotourism provides a sustainable livelihood.
Bamboo crafts give villagers a sustainable livelihood.
The project helps fishermen find a sustainable livelihood.
Beekeeping can be a sustainable livelihood in rural areas.

cards.def:
A person displaced by climate effects
हिंदी: जलवायु शरणार्थी
examples: Rising seas will create millions of climate refugees.
Many climate refugees move from villages to cities.
Rising seas could make island nations climate refugees.
There's no legal status for climate refugees yet.

cards.def:
A sudden destructive natural event
हिंदी: प्राकृतिक आपदा
examples: Early warning systems save lives in natural disasters.
The cyclone was the worst natural disaster in decades.
Keep an emergency kit ready for a natural disaster.
Insurance helps families recover after a natural disaster.

cards.def:
The using up of natural resources
हिंदी: संसाधनों का ह्रास
examples: Resource depletion threatens future generations.
Resource depletion is a risk for mining towns.
Recycling slows resource depletion.
Overuse of water is causing resource depletion in farming areas.
